additional_info.subject: Handover to ES
additional_info.body:
Problem Description: Charging stopped on Mercedes truck on 13th Feb, 9:32 CET
Action Performed:
I checked the logs of the charger and noticed the
ERR_INTERNAL_COMM for SECC (error code 69)
appearing multiple times over the last three weeks. I investigated whether the fault that appeared on the 13th was caused by a specific vehicle. I checked if the same vehicle's MAC address appeared on previous dates when the ERR_INTERNAL_COMM error was logged. However, the MAC address only appears once on the 13th.
• Charger FW Version: 6.0.3
• Reason for Handover: Need to do a deep dive analysis on the error code 69.
• Attachment: Logs of the charger on the specified time stamp and AWS log.
